description: This file defines the ECUEditorManager class, which manages singleton access to an ECUEditor instance within an ECU editing module of the RomRaider project. It provides a thread-safe static accessor method and throws an exception if instantiation fails.

classes.name: ECUEditorManager
classes.description: Manages singleton access to the ECUEditor instance, ensuring thread-safe creation.

methods.name: getECUEditor
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of ECUEditor, initializing it with thread safety if necessary.
